body.x: Praim Co., Ltd. (CEO Baek Mae Soon) has announced its participation in CES 2025 in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10. The company will showcase its innovations in the “K-Startup Pavilion.”

Praim specializes in researching, developing, and manufacturing commercial kitchen appliances, including dishwashers, steam convection ovens, rice cookers, steamers, and automated cleaning systems. With annual sales of approximately 16 billion KRW and exports of 700 million KRW, the company employs around 80 staff members.

Praim positions itself as a “total kitchen one-stop solution” provider. It offers services ranging from kitchen design and installation to detergent supply. Its clients include small restaurants, large-scale operations, schools, hospitals, hotels, and government facilities.

Praim’s automated cleaning systems have been successfully installed at locations like Incheon International Airport and Yonsei University’s cafeteria, as well as in countries such as Vietnam and Malaysia. By integrating robotics into kitchen appliances, Praim leads in kitchen automation and consistent food preparation quality.
The company recently launched an automated beer dispenser cleaner with remote cleaning and monitoring capabilities.

Praim will showcase a variety of commercial dishwashers at CES 2025. These machines are designed for high-capacity, rapid cleaning with a single switch operation. Key features include a multi-angle water spray system that eliminates blind spots, energy-saving capabilities, advanced spray patterns, modern filters, and safety mechanisms.
Praim’s beer dispenser cleaning equipment, leveraging European technology, automatically sanitizes cooling units, beer lines, and taps using a proprietary software system.
With its brands “PRAIM” and “NEONORMA,” the company has expanded to over 15 countries and aims to strengthen its presence in the U.S. market.
“We are dedicated to ongoing research and development,” a Praim representative stated. “Praim’s 3P Process, combined with comprehensive after-sales service, ensures customer satisfaction.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
